description: Etat du trafic en temps réel is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Etat du trafic en temps réel. Données fournies à Rennes Métropole par la société Autoroutes Trafic. Ces données ont un "délai" de 3 minutes, il est donc normal qu'à 15h30, la donnée la plus récente indique 15h27. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are trafic, FCD, temps réel, circulation. The portal shows 2,859 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
